title: Claude Code 2026 Feature Updates
content:
## Overview

From March through June 2026, Claude Code shipped a dense sequence of features that substantially changed how agentic coding sessions work. This page tracks the major additions by theme.

---

## Agent Management

### Agent View (Week 20, May 2026)

`claude agents` opens a single terminal screen listing every active Claude Code session. From this view you can:

- See which sessions are running, blocked waiting for input, or complete
- Read the last response from any session without switching to it
- Jump into a session only when it needs you

This makes parallel multi-session workflows practical — start several agents on different tasks, monitor all of them from one screen, and intervene selectively.

### Dynamic Workflows (Week 22, May 2026)

For very large-scale tasks, Claude can now write and execute **dynamic workflow scripts** that orchestrate dozens to hundreds of subagents. Rather than manually decomposing a task, you describe the goal and Claude generates the orchestration plan, spawns the agents, and assembles results. Nested sub-agents can themselves spawn sub-agents, up to 5 levels deep.

### `/goal` Command (Week 21, May 2026)

The `/goal` slash command sets a completion condition that Claude continues working toward across multiple turns. Claude keeps iterating — running tests, fixing errors, making commits — until the stated condition holds, rather than stopping after one turn.

---

## Code Review

### `/ultrareview` (Week 17, April 2026)

A cloud-based code review fleet: a set of specialized bug-hunting agents runs in Anthropic's infrastructure, analyzes your changes, and sends findings back to your CLI or Desktop. Available as `claude ultrareview` from the CLI and as `/ultrareview` inside a session. Particularly useful for security audits and catching correctness bugs across large diffs.

### `/code-review` Command (Week 21, May 2026)

A lighter-weight in-session review command that reports correctness bugs in the current diff. Runs locally within the session rather than spinning up cloud agents.

### Security Guidance Plugin (Week 22, May 2026)

A plugin that runs alongside Claude as it edits code, reviewing each change for security vulnerabilities in real time. Catches issues like injection vectors, credential leaks, and insecure configurations before they're committed.

---

## Permission & Safety Model

### Auto Mode (Week 13–21, March–May 2026)

Auto mode replaces per-action permission prompts with a classifier-based approach:

- **Safe actions** run without interruption
- **Risky actions** are blocked outright
- **Ambiguous actions** may still prompt

Initially a research preview (Week 13), auto mode became available on Pro accounts in Week 21. It supports Sonnet 4.6 alongside Opus on Pro, and uses background safety checks rather than foreground prompts.

**Hard deny rules** (added Week 19) block actions unconditionally — even if an allow rule would otherwise permit them — providing an override layer for irreversible operations.

---

## Model Updates in Claude Code

| Week | Change |
|------|--------|
| Week 16 (April) | Claude Opus 4.7 becomes default on Max and Team Premium; `xhigh` effort level added |
| Week 20 (May) | Fast mode runs on Opus 4.7 by default |
| Week 22 (May) | Claude Opus 4.8 becomes default; fast mode runs on Opus 4.8 at $10/$50 per MTok (3× cheaper than Opus 4.7 fast mode) |

The `xhigh` effort level (introduced with Opus 4.7) is the recommended setting for most complex coding work. It can be set with `/effort xhigh` or configured as the default in settings.

---

## Platform Improvements

- **Windows native support (Week 18):** Claude Code no longer requires Git Bash on Windows; it uses PowerShell as the shell tool when Bash is absent.
- **Computer use in CLI (Week 14):** Claude can open native desktop apps, click through UI, and verify visual changes from the terminal (research preview).
- **Plugins from ZIP/URL (Week 19):** `--plugin-dir` accepts `.zip` archives and `--plugin-url` fetches plugin packages for the current session.
- **Mobile push notifications (Week 16):** Claude Code on the web sends phone notifications when a long task finishes or Claude needs input.
- **Rate limits doubled:** API rate limits were doubled to support higher-scale development workloads.

---

## Ultraplan (Week 15, April 2026)

A cloud-assisted planning workflow:

1. Draft a plan in the CLI
2. Review and annotate it in a web editor
3. Run it remotely in a cloud environment, or pull it back locally

The first Ultraplan run automatically provisions a cloud environment, removing setup friction for remote execution.
